source: runtime capture (SkyZH) 2026-09-10 花园实测; https://hypixelskyblock.minecraft.wiki/w/Hub_Villagers#Jack (2026-08-18 更新); 交叉核对 https://hypixel-skyblock.fandom.com/wiki/Hub_Villagers
note: Jack 原是大厅村庄里讲属性面板的村民(0.24.2 已从大厅移除),现在只作为花园访客出现。语气像个爱科普的热心村民。
source_note: 实测和 minecraft.wiki 一样写「on the The Garden」(Hypixel 自己多打了一个 The),fandom 写「on the Garden」;以实测为准,不替 Hypixel 改。

messages.raw: §fDid you know that you gain additional §6☘ Farming Fortune §fwhile on the §aThe Garden§f? You can check it in your SkyBlock Profile!
